notes.title: HUGE UPDATE TO HENRY'S DAY!
notes.content:
ZANDER UPDATE: NEW LEVEL+ ENDING

Hey Everybody,

The Zander Update marks the biggest update so far for Henry’s Day. This update expands on the story arch of Zander and his journal entries scattered throughout Summer City. Explore the sewers beneath Summer City, meet new characters and unlock a new ending to Henry’s story.

[previewyoutube=3rsuB1GD9lM;full][/previewyoutube]

Update Features:
-New Level: Summer City Sewers
-New Gameplay Challenges
-New Dialogue
-New Ending
-New Music
-New Achievement
-Minor bug fixes

notes.title: MiniMap Added to Henry's Day!
notes.content:
Hey Everybody,

In this latest update I’ve added a highly requested feature, the MiniMap! I didn’t want to make the gameplay too easy, but I think this version of the Minimap will be very helpful especially to new players. You’ll notice location markers on the Minimap that show which buildings you can enter.

A couple of other small changes made in this update are:

Key bindings patched to allow mouse bindings
Collision removed from bushes in Summer Park

Note: the key bindings auto-apply and auto-save for convenience. If you’ve messed up your key bindings and can’t figure it out, set your bindings to Default and then you can rebind your keys appropriately.

Thank you to everyone for all of your feedback. Keep the comments coming and be on the lookout for a major update coming soon!

notes.title: Music volume patch
notes.content: Fixed issue with Music Volume defaulting to muted after today's update.

notes.title: NEW AND IMPROVED SETTINGS CUSTOMIZATION
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

I'd like to thank everybody for their valuable feedback; Positive or negative, it is all helpful in making Henry's Day a better experience for all. 

In this latest update I have completely revamped the Options Menu to include a full customization of your gameplay experience.

Some of the settings you'll be able to customize include:
-Key Bindings
-Resolution
-Motion Blur
-Anti-Aliasing
-Shadows
-Max FPS
...and more! 

I am also working on a Major Update to Henry's Day that includes a new level and ending. I hope to be finished with this update before the end of the year so be on the lookout for that.

If you'd like to see something added to Henry's Day you can reach me on Discord or by email, both options are available via the Steam Store Page.

Thanks again for being part of this community!

notes.title: Level Optimization
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

People were experience 1-2 second lag times at various locations within Summer City. This lag was caused from the level streaming that I had set up in the game world. In this patch I have optimized the level streaming to remove almost all of the lag.

You'll still notice a small lag time when loading the Zoooble HQ. This time will be longer the first time you boot up the game. Because of how many objects the Zoooble HQ is made up of, I plan to address that in a future update.

I also fixed a couple of audio bugs in this patch.

Thanks for the feedback everyone and keep it coming!

notes.title: Game Release Live Steam!!
notes.content: Today marks the official release of Henry's Day. I'll be livestreaming the game on the steam page for anyone interested in seeing the what the game looks like.

notes.title: Official Release Date!!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

It's been an exciting journey developing Henry's Day and we're approaching the finish line. The release date for the game has been officially set and Henry's Day will be releasing 11.11.21. The game will be available to purchase on Steam for Windows, with the potential for a Mac port in the future. Thank you to everyone who's wishlisted, watched, beta tested, played the demo, etc.

I'm excited for everyone to play the full-version of Henry's Day!

[previewyoutube=ugvBXmsNc_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: FINAL DEV STREAM OF HENRY'S DAY
notes.content: This is the last developer stream of Henry's Day during Steam Next Fest. Join us to see the latest in-game features and find out more about the development and release date of Henry's Day!

notes.title: DEV STREAM OF HENRY'S DAY!
notes.content:
*This is a make-up stream for the day 1 Next Fest stream not showing up*

Caleb here, the developer of Henry's Day.

I'll be streaming the latest version of Henry's Day and going over some key features that have been added to the game since the release of the demo. I will also be telling you how you can get your very own customer NPC in the final version of Henry's Day, don't miss it!

Henry's Day is a dialogue driven adventure game where you play as Henry who is stuck in the same day. Explore your environment, interact with others and discover the real reason behind why Henry is stuck in the same day.

notes.title: Demo Now Live
notes.content:
The Henry's Day Demo is now live and free to play!

Get a feel for the game's mechanics and a taste for the story. Explore an unfinished version of Summer City and get to know some of the people around the city. Learn more about Zoooble and see just how much their influence is growing in the city.

If you beat the Henry's Day Demo, you'll unlock a special prize at the end, your own custom NPC in the final version of Henry's Day!

So what are you waiting for? Try out the Henry's Day Demo today!
